svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of a risk check in fin-primitives, using the real session from the position_risk example. Fills and price marks go into a PositionLedger; its net_liquidation_value (cash plus the market value of open positions) goes into RiskMonitor::update, which runs a MaxDrawdownRule of 4 percent and a MinEquityRule floor of 96,600 and returns a Vec of RiskBreach. Equity peaks at 101,237 after event 5; at event 8, marking MSFT at 371.50, equity is 96,507, drawdown 4.67 percent, and both rules fire.
svg.text: the real session from cargo run --example position_risk, one event at a time
net_liquidation_value(&marks) = cash + market value of open positions
